annotations.title: Draft Shipley Proposal Section & Vendor Clarification Q&A

description: Draft an evaluator-ready Shipley proposal narrative (complete with Win Themes, Feature-Benefit-Proof blocks, and Risk Mitigations) AND a list of strategic Contracting Officer Clarification Q&A questions from an RFP section and company capabilities. This is a read-only, stateless composite generation call that always returns both the drafted narrative and the clarification questions in a single JSON payload (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `target_section_type` selects the proposal section format, and `tone_and_methodology` customizes the writing style). Use this tool when writing Technical Approach, Executive Summary, or Management Plan prose; use `generate_compliance_matrix` instead to build a requirement checklist/outline first, or `generate_cpars_past_performance` for structured Volume III CPARS contract citations.

company_context_and_capabilities.description: Bidder's technical architecture, past performance metrics, SLAs, certifications, and competitive discriminators to weave into the narrative.

rfp_section_text.description: Verbatim RFP Section C/PWS technical requirements, Section L instructions, or Section M evaluation criteria that the drafted proposal section must satisfy.

target_section_type.description: Target proposal section structure: 'technical_approach' (default, solution architecture & requirement execution), 'executive_summary' (vision & discriminators), 'management_and_staffing_plan' (governance, transition & QA), or 'past_performance_narrative' (prose summary).

tone_and_methodology.default: Shipley Proposal Methodology (Active Voice, Evaluator-First, Feature-Benefit-Proof)
tone_and_methodology.description: Editorial voice and methodology instruction applied to the prose draft (defaults to 'Shipley Proposal Methodology (Active Voice, Evaluator-First, Feature-Benefit-Proof)').

name: generate_rfp_response

drafted_narrative_markdown.description: Full Shipley-formatted proposal section prose in Markdown.

section_title.description: Compliance-mapped heading for the drafted proposal section.

strategic_clarification_questions.description: Strategic vendor Q&A questions to submit to the Contracting Officer to expose ambiguous or competitor-wired specs.

win_themes_and_discriminators.description: Key win themes and ghosting points embedded in the draft.
